authors: Stefania Zourlidou, Jens Golze, Monika Sester
name: luh-groundtruth-intersection-regulators-for-chicago
notes:
This dataset contains the ground-truth intersection regulators for all intersections crossed by the open GPS trajectory data of Chicago, published on [Mapconstruction.org](http://mapconstruction.org).

## Data Acquisition
The ground-truth data is generated by manually inspecting images at the intersections crossed by the published trajectory dataset on [Mapconstruction.org](http://mapconstruction.org). These images are derived from [mapillary.com](https://www.mapillary.com/) at the respective intersections. Satellite images are investigated as an additional data source, if needed. This procedure result in labels for each intersection arm.
